text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
“Not just cute!
A wild, slightly dangerous,
cool, mature woman”...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Fufun♪ I can't wait, I can't wait! ☆
A super cool photoshoot with Brian-san♪
Even if I was a little pushy asking for it!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: If the theme is wild and dangerous, taking a photo with Brian-san would be perfect, right?♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian?
text_block_list.text: —Sorry to keep you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ah, Brian-sa... n...?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Nay, it is I!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I have heard the tale from that wondrous beast, O glorious blossoming spring wind!!
Thy wish—shall be granted!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait, what!?
It's Gimlet-san, not Brian-san!?
And Trainer's here too!? Whyyy!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Ah... That match race got moved to tomorrow?
It's sudden, but works for me. ...See ya.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: "...Tomorrow? Come to think of it—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
…………Tch. Hey, Gimlet.
You probably like photos and stuff anyway, right—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"—And there you have it. Heheh...
I even brought the Magic Lantern Master with me!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehhー! Maya wanted to take a photo
that was "wild and a little dangerous," though—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
No problem!
A rose concealing wild ferocity... that too is me!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Mmm, well... But indeed... Gimlet-san kind of has that vibe too, maybe?
choice_data_list: It's a bit of a different direction, though.
It's a bit of a different direction, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still feeling a little uneasy, we changed
locations and began shooting, but—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Hrm, mmghh~!
I feel like... it's cool, but
something's just missiiing~...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...I see. O blooming spring breeze,
there is one thing you are mistaken about.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh, what is it!? Tell me, tell me!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
What you're doing right now is merely imitating the Black Rose.
Just tracing the surface of those so-called 'beautiful thorns'—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Show me the brilliance of your own light that shines in a single fleeting moment!
Bet everything on this very instant!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
“Indeed, just like my racing attire,
which shines brightest in that single instant—!”
choice_data_list: It shines precisely because it's in the moment?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Yeah. —Look!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wah, the decorations chime and sway, so pretty~☆
The more you move, the more sparkly this outfit gets!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Well noticed!
The sparkle born from one's conduct exists solely in that very fleeting moment!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Because I always carry it, my soul too—
must burn fiercely in this fleeting instant.
Wearing this makes me feel that way.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
The brilliance of a single moment...
Yeah, I think I kind of get it now.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya will go change too!
I wanna try that "betting it all on a single moment" thing!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Ah—show me a glimpse of that brilliance!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Here I go—
At times, blazing like Hestia's hearth!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Second flight! Next up, let's look cool☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Final flight!
Ending it on a mature note... ☆"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now, shoot!! Capture this fleeting moment,
this brilliance that will fade away in an instant—!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Wah, awesome! You got a great shot!
Thanks to both of you!
It really looks 'wild and a little dangerous'!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Right, right?
For some reason, when I took pictures with Gimlet-san—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"In this single moment, I wanna be the absolute best me!"
...is what Maya thought, just a tiny bit☆
So this is what it means to "bet it all on a moment"!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, quite the spirited one, aren't you... I like it!
You've certainly entertained me quite a bit as well!!
choice_data_list: What are you going to do with this cool photo?
What are you going to do with this cool photo?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, quite the spirited one, aren't you... I like it!
You've certainly entertained me quite a bit as well!!
choice_data_list: What are you going to do with this cool photo?
What are you going to do with this cool photo?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should go show Brian-san?
Like, "Look at the great photo I took thanks to you!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, splendid. Those phantom lanterns—
show them what you've got!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh... Brian-san!
Feast your eyes on this cool, mature photo~☆

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Heh, see?
As expected, they're the best fit for something like this."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It seems we took a photo
that anyone would be satisfied with!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. I see.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
So you saw this brilliance as well.
As expected, it was not time wasted...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Wh-What the...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Gimlet-san might look the most mature today
right now~?!
